evidence_against.relevance: Casey's frequent initiation and approximately weekly one-on-one time show sustained interest and effort.
Helping with an important interview and attending an important birthday dinner demonstrate meaningful support.
Casey independently resumed regular contact after periods apart, indicating continued interest.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Casey twice declined to define the relationship and offered no timeline for revisiting it, supporting low commitment.
Meetings were usually convenient for Casey or arranged at short notice, and Casey twice prioritized other commitments over advance plans.
Casey has not integrated Drew into close social or family circles and declined a future event because it required planning two months ahead.

recommended_action.explanation: Drew should state the level of commitment and planning desired and ask whether Casey is willing to meet it; if Casey remains unwilling to clarify, Drew can set an appropriate boundary.

uncertainty_explanation: Casey shows consistent contact, practical support, and renewed initiative after time apart, but the repeated avoidance of definition, limited advance planning, convenience-oriented meetings, cancellations, and lack of social integration more strongly support low-commitment involvement.
